shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; git status --short | head -20

cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; cat .gitignore; echo ---; ls -R src; echo ---; cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -50
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch Button Icon 2>&1 | head -80; echo ---; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -120
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm | head -80; echo ---; grep -rl "useThemeValue\|useThemeType\|useTheme\b" build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && ls; echo ---; cat index.d.ts useTheme.d.ts useThemeValue.d.ts useThemeType.d.ts; echo ---; cat ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat ThemeProvider/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/types.d.ts theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts theme/ThemeContext.d.ts; echo ---; cat theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -150; echo ---; find . -path '*Switch*' -name '*.d.ts' | head;

cat Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo ---; grep -n "Switch" ../../../../../../node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; cat ../index.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; cat theme/getThemeType.d.ts; cat theme/getThemeType.js
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "interface ControlProps" -A 25 components/types.d.ts; echo ---; cat components/Switch/Switch.js | head -60

cd /tmp && timeout 20 curl -sS -o /tmp/uikit7-llms.txt -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -l /tmp/uikit7-llms.txt 2>/dev/null; grep -n -i "theme" /tmp/uikit7-llms.txt 2>/dev/null | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && grep -n "theme" index.d.ts; echo ---; cat Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls Flex | head; echo ---; grep -n "direction\|gap\|alignItems" Flex/*.d.ts | head; echo ---; grep -rn "export.*variant\|TextVariant" Text/*.d.ts | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; echo ---; cat Text/Text.d.ts | head -40
grep -n "spacing" layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "view\|size" Button/Button.d.ts | head -12
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat
